description:
Take a published post off the site: its page 404s and it goes back to draft. The post itself is kept and can be published again later; emails already sent are not recalled. Same as `micropage posts unpublish <slug>`.

Needs confirm: true, which you should only pass after the user has agreed. Queues a site rebuild when the project has been published. The site rebuild redeploys the live build, so an unpublished page draft left by save_page or the editor stays a draft. It returns build_id and after_event_id to follow the rebuild with get_deploy_status. To remove a post for good use delete_post instead.

confirm.description: Must be true. Ask the user first: this changes the live site.

project.description: Which project: its uuid, its numeric id, its micropage hostname ("acme" or "acme.micropage.sh") or its custom domain ("www.acme.com"). A full URL also works. Get valid values from list_projects.

slug.description: The post's slug, as list_posts shows it (e.g. "launching-new-dashboard"). Normalised like the CLI does.

name: unpublish_post

after_event_id.description: Pass to get_deploy_status with build_id to see only events from this rebuild.

build_id.description: The build the site rebuild redeploys: the live one, not an unpublished page draft. Pass to get_deploy_status; null when nothing was rebuilt.

rebuild_queued.description: True when a site rebuild of the live build was queued to take the post down.

title: Unpublish a micropage post
